description.en: The four giant worlds beyond the asteroid belt — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Vast, stormy, and ringed with wonder.
description.hr: Cetiri divovska svijeta iza asteroidnog pojasa — Jupiter, Saturn, Uran i Neptun. Ogromni, olujni i optoceni cudima.

back.en: A huge planet made mostly of hydrogen and helium, with no solid surface to stand on. Jupiter and Saturn are the classic examples.
back.hr: Ogromna planeta sastavljena uglavnom od vodika i helija, bez cvrste povrsine na koju bi stao. Jupiter i Saturn su klasicni primjeri.

back.en: The largest planet — all the others could fit inside it twice over. It's so massive it's essentially a failed star.
back.hr: Najveca planeta — sve ostale bi stale u njega dvaput. Toliko je masivan da je u biti neuspjela zvijezda.

media.image_hint: NASA/Hubble ili Juno snimak Jupitera s Velikom crvenom pjegom. Trazi 'Jupiter' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: What is Jupiter's Great Red Spot?
front.hr: Sta je Jupiterova Velika crvena pjega?

back.en: A giant storm bigger than Earth that has raged for at least 350 years. A hurricane that never ends.
back.hr: Divovska oluja veca od Zemlje koja bjesni najmanje 350 godina. Uragan koji nikad ne prestaje.

front.en: What are Saturn's rings made of?

back.en: Billions of chunks of ice and rock, from dust grains to house-sized blocks. Wide as they are, they're only about 10 m thick on average.
back.hr: Milijarde komada leda i stijene, od zrna prasine do blokova velicine kuce. Koliko god siroki, u prosjeku su debeli samo oko 10 m.

media.image_hint: NASA/Cassini snimak Saturna s prstenovima. Trazi 'Saturn Cassini' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: Which planet could float on water?
front.hr: Koja bi planeta plutala na vodi?

back.en: Saturn. It's the least dense planet — if there were a bathtub big enough, it would float.
back.hr: Saturn. Najmanje je gusta planeta — kad bi postojala dovoljno velika kada, plutao bi.

front.en: What is unusual about how Uranus spins?
front.hr: Sta je neobicno u nacinu na koji se Uran okrece?

back.en: It rolls on its side, tilted about 98°. Its poles take turns facing the Sun, giving decades-long seasons.
back.hr: Kotrlja se na boku, nagnut oko 98°. Polovi mu se smjenjuju prema Suncu, dajuci godisnja doba duga desetljecima.

media.image_hint: NASA/Voyager 2 ili JWST snimak Urana. Trazi 'Uranus' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

back.en: Methane in its atmosphere absorbs red light and reflects blue. It's a deep, vivid azure world.
back.hr: Metan u njegovoj atmosferi apsorbuje crvenu svjetlost i reflektuje plavu. Duboki, zivi azurni svijet.

media.image_hint: NASA/Voyager 2 snimak Neptuna. Trazi 'Neptune' na images.nasa.gov. Javno vlasnistvo.

front.en: Where do the fastest winds in the Solar System blow?
front.hr: Gdje pusu najbrzi vjetrovi u Suncevom sistemu?

back.en: On Neptune — up to about 2,000 km/h, faster than the speed of sound on Earth. And it's the farthest, coldest planet.
back.hr: Na Neptunu — do oko 2.000 km/h, brze od brzine zvuka na Zemlji. A najdalja je i najhladnija planeta.

front.en: How many moons does Jupiter have?

back.en: Nearly 100 confirmed. The four largest — Io, Europa, Ganymede and Callisto — were spotted by Galileo in 1610.
back.hr: Gotovo 100 potvrdjenih. Cetiri najveca — Ija, Europa, Ganimed i Kalisto — Galileo je uocio 1610.

front.en: Which moon might hide an ocean of liquid water?
front.hr: Koji bi mjesec mogao kriti ocean tekuce vode?

back.en: Jupiter's moon Europa. Beneath its icy crust likely lies a global ocean — one of the best places to search for life.
back.hr: Jupiterov mjesec Europa. Ispod ledene kore vjerovatno lezi globalni ocean — jedno od najboljih mjesta za potragu za zivotom.

front.en: Do the other giants have rings too?
front.hr: Imaju li i drugi divovi prstenove?

back.en: Yes — Jupiter, Uranus and Neptune all have faint rings. Saturn's are just by far the brightest and widest.
back.hr: Da — Jupiter, Uran i Neptun svi imaju slabe prstenove. Saturnovi su samo daleko najsjajniji i najsiri.

front.en: How long is a year on Neptune?

back.en: About 165 Earth years. Since its discovery in 1846, Neptune has completed just one full orbit of the Sun (in 2011).
back.hr: Oko 165 zemaljskih godina. Od otkrica 1846., Neptun je zavrsio tek jedan pun krug oko Sunca (2011.).
